# Glossary

<!-- docsync:auto:begin - generated by docsync, edits inside this block are overwritten -->
> **Section status: CURRENT** - reviewed 2026-11-20; not tied to specific files, so it never goes stale.
<!-- docsync:auto:end -->

<!-- Every domain word, internal code name and overloaded term. If the code uses two names for one thing,
     or one name for two things, say so here. Keep alphabetical. -->

| Term | Meaning in this system | Where it lives in code | Not to be confused with |
|---|---|---|---|
| Activity | A synthesised Python function used as a workflow step (profile "activity"). Registered in the Tool Service like a tool and shown in the Activity Gallery. | `tool-service/app/synthesis/profiles/`, `frontend-3/src/routes/workflows.activities.*` | A Temporal activity, although compiled workflows do run them as Temporal activities. |
| Admin (platform admin) | An operator of the whole platform, stored in `auth_admins`. Has no workspace permissions. | `backend/app/auth/`, `routes/admin.py` | The `maintainer` role, which has every workspace permission. |
| Agent | A Mistral agent (Agents API) with model, instructions, tools, connectors and libraries. Created by the agent pipeline or by hand. | `services/agent_service.py`, `layers/agent/` | A workflow step of type `agent`, which calls an agent. |
| Annotation | A link from a subject (agent, workflow, tool, library) to catalog concepts, such as `serves_domain`. | `catalog/models.py` (`ontology_annotations`), `catalog/tagging.py` | A rule assignment. |
| Archetype | A pattern for an agent (for example "task agent for fixed-step extraction"), from the catalog seed. | `catalog/seed/`, `layers/agent/` | An agent tier. |
| Background run ("run") | A persisted pipeline job that keeps going when the page closes: kinds `agent`, `workflow-plan`, `workflow-refine`, `workflow-verify`, `agent-evaluate`, `synthesis` and `rebuild`. | `backend/app/runs/`, `routes/runs.py`, `frontend-3/src/lib/runs/` | A workflow execution, or an op. |
| Build prerequisite | A credential, setting or fact a build needs, settled from the vault or by asking the user before code is written. | `backend/app/build_prereqs/` | A workflow run prerequisite (`/workflows/<n>/prerequisites`), which is checked before a run. |
| Catalog / ontology | The controlled vocabulary of schemes and concepts. The code and URLs say "ontology" (`/api/ontology`, `ontology_*` tables); the package and UI say "Catalog". | `backend/app/catalog/`, legacy aliases in `app/ontology/` | A library ontology (RAG), which is a per-library entity schema. |
| Codegen R1–R8 | The backend pipeline that turns a code need into a built tool or activity: specify, screen, credential check, author, contract, build, smoke test, bind. | `backend/app/layers/codegen/` | Synthesis G1–G10, which runs inside the Tool Service and is called by R6. |
| Concept | A node in a catalog scheme, with a dotted id (for example `domain.finance_ops`). | `catalog/models.py` (`ontology_concepts`) | A RAG graph entity. |
| Connector | A Mistral connector (directory or custom MCP) attached to agents. | `routes/connectors.py`, `services/connector_service.py` | A locally registered MCP server (`/mcp`) in the Tool Service. |
| Decision layer | A pipeline layer that asks the model one focused question and expects JSON back, through `core/decision.decide`. | `backend/app/core/decision.py` | A user decision (below). |
| Dry run | Executing a workflow with simulated or sample inputs during verification, to find wiring faults before saving. | `services/workflow_engine/dry_run.py`, `layers/workflow/verify_layers.py` | A real local execution. |
| Execution | One run of a workflow. Local executions are in `local_executions`; Mistral Workflows executions live at Mistral. Both are shown through `/workflows/executions/*`. | `services/workflow_engine/run_history.py`, `routes/executions.py` | A background run. |
| Fault class | The classification of a synthesis failure: code, spec, harness or transport. It decides whether to repair, respecify or retry. | `tool-service/app/synthesis/` | An HTTP error class. |
| Guardrail | A Mistral moderation guardrail configured on an agent. | `layers/agent/`, `layers/workflow/guardrail_layer.py` | A rule, or a tool-safety rule. |
| Human review | A workflow step of type `human_review` that waits for a person to approve, edit or reject. Stored in `human_reviews`. | `services/workflow_engine/reviews.py`, `/reviews` | Approving a pending tool. |
| Knowledge item | A build-guidance or reference entry with conditions and status (proposed, active, retired). Distilled from sources or added by hand. | `backend/app/knowledge/` | Library documents (RAG), or process documents. |
| Layer | One step of a creation pipeline, an object with `run(ctx, next)`. Reports through pipeline events and is shown on the UI timelines. | `backend/app/core/`, `backend/app/layers/` | A stage, which is a group of layers drawn as one timeline row. |
| Library | A Mistral document library (Libraries API) used for retrieval by agents, and optionally extracted into the Neo4j graph. | `routes/libraries.py`, `backend/app/rag/` | The tool registry. |
| MCP server | A Model Context Protocol server registered with the Tool Service and called over JSON-RPC. | `tool-service/app/services/mcp_manager.py`, `routes/tools.py` (`/mcp/*`) | A Mistral connector. |
| Op | A short request tagged with `X-Op-Id` whose progress streams from `/api/ops/{id}/events`. | `backend/app/progress/`, `frontend-3/src/lib/ops/` | A background run. |
| Orchestrator | The home-page chat that designs agents (the agent pipeline). Also `POST /orchestrate`. | `routes/orchestrator.py`, `services/orchestrator_service.py`, `frontend-3/src/routes/index.tsx` | The workflow planner. |
| Process document | A structured description of a business process (template v1 or v2) attached to a process concept and used when planning. | `backend/app/process/` | A knowledge item. |
| Profile | The synthesis target kind, `tool` or `activity`, which changes prompts, contract and checks. | `tool-service/app/synthesis/profiles/` | A user profile. |
| Provider account | A cloud account login (for example Brev) used to provision remote servers. One row per provider, shared by every workspace. | `remote_server_model.py` (`remote_provider_accounts`) | A workspace. |
| Registry | The Tool Service's versioned store of tools and activities (status pending, active, rejected; versions by name and hash). | `tool-service/app/synthesis/registry.py` | The Mistral agent list. |
| Remote server | A deployment target (SSH host, Brev instance, cloud VM) for workflow workers or tools. | `backend/app/remote_servers/`, `remote_servers` table | An MCP server. |
| Revision | A proposed change set to a saved workflow (operations, diff), applied to create a new version. | `backend/app/workflow_revisions/` | A version, which is an applied, restorable snapshot. |
| Rule | A check from the rule catalog (for example "require human review before payment"), scoped always-on or attached to agents or workflows, enforced at creation and run time. | `backend/app/rules/` | A tool-safety rule, a guardrail, or a knowledge item. |
| Stage | A named group of layers drawn as one timeline row; also a rewind point. | `core/stages.py` | A Mistral Workflows stage, which does not exist. |
| Step | One node of a workflow: agent, tool, connector, condition, transform or human_review. | `services/workflow_engine/` | A pipeline layer. |
| Synthesis G1–G10 | The Tool Service pipeline: spec, policy, test plan, author, sandbox run, verifiers, repair, register. | `tool-service/app/synthesis/` | Codegen R1–R8. |
| Tier | An agent's level: foundation, domain or use case. Decided by the identity layer and shown by `TierSelector`. Foundation agents are filed under the System domain. | `layers/agent/`, `/ontology/tiers` | A pricing tier. |
| Tool | A synthesised or built-in Python function callable by agents (function calling), run by the Tool Service. | `tool-service/`, `services/tool_resolver.py` | An activity, or a connector tool. |
| Tool gap | A capability a workflow needs that no existing agent, tool, activity or connector provides. It triggers codegen. | `layers/workflow/tool_gap_layer.py` | A missing build prerequisite. |
| Tool-safety rule | A policy on what synthesised code may do (for example network or filesystem), seeded switched off. | `backend/app/safety/`, `/safety-rules` | A rule. |
| User decision | A question a background run asks the user, with a countdown and a default. | `runs/manager.py` (decisions) | A decision layer. |
| Vault secret | An encrypted credential bound to its entry, with versions and audit. Referenced as `vault:<ref>`, never by value. | `backend/app/vault/` | A Settings value, or a remote-server secret, which is Fernet-encrypted separately. |
| Version (workflow) | An applied snapshot of a workflow definition, restorable and undoable. | `workflow_revisions/models.py` (`workflow_versions`) | A tool version in the registry. |
| Worker | The Mistral Workflows (Temporal) worker process that runs compiled workflows, one per workspace, supervised by the backend. | `auth/workers.py`, `services/mistral_worker.py` | A Uvicorn worker, or the Tool Service. |
| Workflow | A DAG of steps with an input schema. Saved in `workflow_definitions`, run locally or compiled to a Mistral Workflows module. | `services/workflow_engine/engine.py` | A background run of kind `workflow-plan`. |
| Workspace | An isolated tenant tied to one Mistral API key. Data rows carry `workspace_id`. | `backend/app/auth/` (`auth_workspaces`), `auth/scoping.py` | A Mistral organisation or workspace. |
